entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
I understand. Sometimes the band can take a little getting used to. Did you have a chance to explore the custom workout plans? Many users find that feature really changes their experience.

Look, it wasn't for me. It was for my husband. We had a family emergency right after it arrived. He was supposed to take it on his deployment, but he ended up in the hospital and required surgery. It's been sitting in the box ever since.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear about that. My apologies. I hope he's recovering well. Let me just pull up our return guidelines for you... just a second.
Alright, I've checked the policy here. It looks like you're all set. Our policy states that you have 90 days from the date of delivery for a return, so you're well within that timeframe.
So you'll just... take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing that for you now. I've just sent a prepaid return label and instructions to the email address on your account. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be processed to your original payment method.
You're most welcome. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
Okay. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I wish your husband a swift recovery. Have a good rest of your day.
